title: Pogo Penguin's Wobbly Ice Bridge | Building Story for Kids

music.personality: bright Antarctic building march with controlled wobble rhythms
music.emotional_arrangement: pizzicato bass and brushed snow percussion for measuring; off-centre marimba accents for the narrow wobble; increasingly even mallet patterns as supports, rails and braces settle; full drum, xylophone, chime and cymbal theatre refrain only after the crossing

voices.delivery: rhythmic acted engineering story-song with planted pauses and a sung theatre payoff; no flat reading

continuity.pogo: one young emperor penguin with navy head and back, white belly, golden cheek patches, coral knitted scarf and tan builder belt
continuity.mina: one taller chinstrap penguin with charcoal chin line, violet knitted beanie and teal tool satchel
continuity.site: one visibly knee-deep powder-bottom snow trench between a supply bank and a colourful open-front snow theatre; no open water or deep crevasse
continuity.bridge: one wide translucent ice deck on three evenly spaced rounded blue supports, one rope rail on each opposite side and one teal X brace beneath
continuity.delivery: one small blue-and-coral drum and one brass xylophone remain secured until the verified one-at-a-time crossing

scenes.action: Pogo measures the shallow trench while Mina sorts wide and narrow ice pieces, three supports and two rails beside the secured instruments.
lyrics: Music waits across the snowy dip.
Pogo measures; Mina sorts the pieces.
Build it wide, level, steady!
scenes.hero: safe site, destination and building pieces

scenes.action: Pogo tests one narrow plank with planted feet while Mina spots from the bank; it flexes mildly without cracking.
lyrics: First, the narrow plank gets tested.
Pogo bends; the ice wiggles.
Mina spots him from the bank.

scenes.action: The narrow lane and a wider level deck sit side by side while the builders visibly compare their widths and stability.
lyrics: Narrow wobbles; wider rests level.
Press wide; watch the deck stay.
Wide and stable wins the test!

scenes.action: Exactly three rounded supports form one evenly spaced row; Mina slides the third while Pogo sights along a knotted rope.
lyrics: One, two, three supports in line.
Mina slides the third one gently.
Pogo checks the even gaps.

scenes.action: Pogo and Mina attach exactly one continuous rope rail to each opposite side, leaving the wide centre path clear.
lyrics: A rope rail guards each side.
Left and right stay matched.
Middle path is clear and wide.

scenes.action: Two identical snow sacks load the deck centre while a brass plumb bead hangs straight and the builders inspect the result from the banks.
lyrics: Two snow sacks test the middle.
The plumb bead hangs straight down.
Level bridge, you passed the load!
scenes.hero: even load and straight plumb bead

scenes.action: A gentle breeze sways flags and rails, so Pogo and Mina add two teal straps crossed into one visible X beneath the deck.
lyrics: A breeze makes handrails sway.
Crossed straps steady every side.
Plumb bead settles near the centre.
scenes.hero: X brace and settling plumb bead

scenes.action: Only Pogo crosses with the drum; Mina, the xylophone and sled remain completely on the starting bank for a later trip.
lyrics: Pogo carries the drum alone.
One slow step, then one more.
Mina waits for her own turn.

scenes.action: Inside the theatre Pogo, Mina and two supporting players perform while the completed empty bridge remains visible through the arch.
lyrics: Wide, level, steady; we built it!
Drum and xylophone sing together.
Strong teamwork bridges every beat!
scenes.hero: first full performance and intact bridge payoff

quality_requirements: The trench remains visibly shallow with a powder bottom; no open water, deep crevasse, breakage, falling or fear imagery appears.
Pogo, Mina, costumes, sled, drum, xylophone, theatre and site geography retain identity.
The narrow plank is tested before the wide deck is selected; the final deck stays wide and level.
Exactly three supports, one rail per opposite side and one crossed teal brace are established before crossing.
The two sacks are test weights only and are removed before Pogo crosses.
Only Pogo and the drum occupy the bridge in scene 8; Mina, sled and xylophone remain on the starting bank.
The first full performance occurs only in scene 9 and the deterministic end card follows it as the final event.
Real ice flex, rope, snow, plumb, footstep, drum, xylophone, chime and cymbal effects replace spoken imitation words.
